_why: Pins browser-tool discovery and Electron input behavior. Typed locators encode an omitted selector as an empty string; decoding must preserve their accessible criteria while direct empty selectors remain invalid. Typed log timestamps use integer milliseconds while raw event timestamps retain source precision. Capability queries identify the requested backend without changing selection and never advertise unavailable operations as supported. Browser computer scroll uses a viewport-centered wheel event by default because a synthesized gesture at the top-left could stall on document editors.

capabilityQueries.selection: A query reports the requested browserId and the unchanged selectedBrowserId; tool metadata identifies the queried backend.

fileUpload.reason: Browser acknowledgement and subsequent page-owned input state are different facts. A page may clear or replace an input synchronously after receiving its real files.
fileUpload.permission: Only an actual Not allowed protocol error produces local-file access guidance; no permission preflight blocks an otherwise accepted upload.
fileUpload.completion: A browser acknowledgement is not evidence that the site's server completed an upload.

batchFailure.reason: A stopped batch must expose failure and retain completed side effects across both host and engine tool results.

modalPresentation.reason: Native browser views paint above renderer HTML. Modal overlays must temporarily park the view and display a noninteractive still inside its panel until the overlay closes, preserving the live page and keyboard access to the dialog.
modalPresentation.nested: Keep the browser parked until the last visible overlay leaves.
modalPresentation.capture: Read only the page already on screen; never create a tab, select another page or wake a background page.
modalPresentation.restore: Resume the same existing tab or the latest explicit scoped open; cancel stale captures and restores across task or tab changes.

permissionDefaults.reason: Screen wake locks keep the display awake without prompting. Storage persistence requests settle silently without an implicit grant or a remembered user denial; explicit permission decisions still take precedence and ordinary site storage remains available.

runPreview.producer: exact host dynamic tool run_preview; its URL and name come from structured arguments, never terminal text
runPreview.background: one task-owned Browser page is created without changing the selected page or revealing the panel
runPreview.manual: the tool has an ordinary activity row; website resources in assistant replies provide independent opening actions
runPreview.history: replay renders tool details without navigation; a website action opens the referenced URL on explicit click
runPreview.scope: host checks session, focus revision, URL policy and the tool-call key on each visible action

siteReferences.producer: a completed turn's final reply and its own edits: exactly one local server address with a port, otherwise exactly one edited HTML page; internet links in prose are citations and never become resources, and cited or linked documents replace any website (see end-resource-vectors.json)
siteReferences.projections: turn-end resource list before message actions, conversation output rows in the overview, and output type and icon in turn hover previews
siteReferences.opening: row click opens a local URL with the remembered local target or a page in the work panel preview; the Open in menu lists Klaus, operating-system applications for the target and copy link; menu choices do not change the remembered target
siteReferences.state: a page card shows its own title and icon; only the menu loads applications, and opening failures show a notification
siteReferences.history: resources replay from saved final replies and file-change records with no navigation and historical sessions remain clickable

interactiveWidget.producer: exact host dynamic show_widget tool bound to the session and tool call; replace or unique patch with restricted project/widget or user skill template paths
interactiveWidget.snapshot: host-owned immutable revision file, content hash checked when granting and serving a session-scoped capability URL
interactiveWidget.media: separate klaus-media://widget token with sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms, no same-origin, connect-src none, form-action none, and host-blocked child frame navigation; ordinary previews retain their stricter CSP
interactiveWidget.message: only the exact opaque iframe source with matching session, widget, revision and nonce may send bounded pure JSON to the top-level chat handler
interactiveWidget.submission: submit:false changes only the draft; submit:true requires a top-level user confirmation and a fresh revision check before a clean message is queued or sent
interactiveWidget.negative: no iframe scripts during tool execution, no cross-session or stale-revision interaction, no implicit send or foreign draft/attachment inclusion
